```artifact
Feature: Prescription Generation and Mapping
  As a healthcare system
    Background:
      Given a fully operational Patient Consultation Request and Chemist/Lab modules

    #1 Generates One Prescription from One Patient Consultation Request
    @U18_5
    Scenario: Generates a prescription for a standard consultation request
    @kind: positive
    Given a Patient Consultation Request with standard information
    When the system processes the request
    Then exactly one prescription should be generated

    #2 Generates One Prescription from One Patient Consultation Request with invalid data
    @kind: negative
    Given a Patient Consultation Request with invalid data
    When the system attempts to process the request
    Then an error should be thrown indicating invalid input

    #3 Maps Prescription to One and Only One Patient Consultation Request
    @U18_5
    Scenario: Mapping of Prescription to Patient Consultation Request
    Given a Prescription exists
    When the system attempts to map it back to the Patient Consultation Request
    Then exactly one Patient Consultation Request should be linked to the Prescription

    #4 Chemist Receives One or More Prescriptions
    @BR-9-1
    Scenario: Chemist receives multiple prescriptions
    @kind: positive
    Given multiple Prescriptions exist
    When the system assigns them to a Chemist
    Then all Prescriptions should be assigned to the Chemist

    #5 Chemist Receives One or More Prescriptions with only required fields
    @BR-9-2
    Scenario: Chemist receives prescriptions with only required fields
    @kind: positive
    Given multiple Prescriptions with only required fields
    When the system assigns them to a Chemist
    Then all Prescriptions should be correctly processed without errors

    #6 Maps Prescription to One and Only One Chemist
    @BR-9-2
    Scenario: Ensuring unique Chemist assignment
    Given multiple Prescriptions with only required fields
    When the system assigns them to a Chemist
    Then exactly one Chemist should be assigned

    #7 Lab Receives One or More Prescriptions
    @BR-10-1
    Scenario: Lab receives multiple prescriptions
    @kind: positive
    Given multiple Prescriptions exist
    When the system assigns them to a Lab
    Then all Prescriptions should be assigned

    #8 Lab Receives One or More Prescriptions with only required fields
    @BR-10-2
    Scenario: Lab receives prescriptions with only required fields
    @kind: positive
    Given multiple Prescriptions with only required fields
    When the system assigns them to a Lab
    Then all Prescriptions should be correctly processed without errors

    #9 Maps Prescription to One and Only One Lab
    @BR-10-2
    Scenario: Ensuring unique Lab assignment
    Given multiple Prescriptions with only required fields
    When the system assigns them to a Lab
    Then exactly one Lab should be assigned
```
